Problem

Handlers repeatedly derive a legacy encryption key, build the same four-item payload wrapper, then call EncryptResult with the same success arguments. The same mechanism appears thirty-one times outside workers.

  • Preserve payload encryption, success constants, response envelopes, and per-handler error handling.
  • Replace every matching non-worker encryption chain.
  • Test the helper by decrypting its output and comparing the original payload.
  • Exclude EncryptResultV1 slim encryption and decryption flows.
  • Do not change workers, endpoint contracts, or dependencies.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Helper output decrypts to the original payload using the legacy derived key.
  • All thirty-one matching non-worker call sites use Functions.EncryptResponse.
  • No direct non-worker EncryptResult call remains.
  • The direct KeyEncrypt call used by decryption remains unchanged.
  • Existing HTTP error handling and response envelopes remain at each caller.
  • Focused tests and go test ./... succeed.
  • git diff --check succeeds.
